home.steps.1.title: 1. Choose your Tree

home.steps.2.title: 2. Personalize your Gift

nosotros.subtitle: Dárboles was born as the bridge to reconnect people through the most elemental and meaningful gift there is: a living tree, delivered directly into the hands of the people you love.
nosotros.sec1.title: The Greenwashing Problem
nosotros.sec1.p1: For decades, the carbon credit market and corporate reforestation (greenwashing) have relied on opaque metrics and empty certificates. Buying abstract "credits" with no geographically audited backing became the standard of a complacent industry.
nosotros.sec1.p2: We decided to eradicate that illusion. Dárboles bridges the gap between cold mathematics and the purity of the Latin American jungle.
nosotros.sec2.title: Radically Transparent Operability
nosotros.sec2.p1: Every tree you sponsor is not a symbol; it is a biological organism registered in our database, positioned with exact GPS coordinates in the mountains of Costa Rica, one of the most protected and dense ecosystems on the planet.
nosotros.sec2.p2: That's why every gift comes with the guidance needed for this act of love to become oxygen, shade, and a legacy that will last for decades or centuries in our wonderful local ecosystems.
nosotros.anchor: Dárboles doesn't sell trees — it sells a measurable, auditable environmental investment with a follow-up guarantee.
nosotros.tomato.title: A program by TOMATO
nosotros.tomato.desc: Dárboles was born inside TOMATO, the company behind institutional reforestation projects in Costa Rica. We inherited its forestry engineering and GPS traceability technology to follow the growth of every tree you gift.
nosotros.guardian.title: You become an Ecosystem Guardian
nosotros.guardian.desc: Once you register your tree on the platform, you're not just the buyer: you become its Guardian, with access to its exact location and its growth story over time.

priv.title: Privacy Policy
priv.sec1.title: 1. Information We Collect
priv.sec1.p: At Dárboles we only collect the information necessary to manage your account, process payments, and maintain our subscription operations. This includes your name, email, and billing preferences. We do not store payment methods directly; we use certified processors (Stripe / 4Geeks) for that purpose.
priv.sec2.title: 2. Botanical Data Processing and Recipients
priv.sec2.p: When you gift a tree, we ask for the recipient's email. This information is only used to notify them of their gift certificate. We do not sell or transfer this data to third parties or advertising agencies. Requests from companies are handled by TOMATO (see section 5).
priv.sec3.title: 3. Analysis and Improvements
priv.sec3.p: We may collect technical metadata (essential cookies, IP addresses for traffic metrics) with the exclusive purpose of optimizing the platform, transparency dashboard loading speeds, and guaranteeing a smooth B2B and D2C experience.
priv.sec4.title: 4. Your Control Rights
priv.sec4.p: You maintain absolute power over your data on our server. You can request its complete deletion from our records by directly contacting us at privacy@darboles.com, except for the cryptographic record of your tree planting if applicable, which is kept anonymous for ESG audits.

terms.sec1.title: 1. Who sells
terms.sec1.p: Dárboles is a program of TOMATO COSTA RICA ANY S.R.L., legal ID 3-102-876296, with registered address at Botánica #59, San José district, Alajuela canton, Alajuela, Costa Rica. You can reach us on WhatsApp at +506 7080-8613 or through the channels on our Contact page. By placing an order on darboles.com you accept these terms.
terms.sec2.title: 2. What you buy
terms.sec2.p: You buy a living fruit or ornamental tree, grown in Costa Rican nurseries and delivered in plantable packaging, together with a gift certificate with a registration code. The certificate records the gift; it is not a property title, a carbon credit or an emissions offset.
terms.sec3.title: 3. Prices and payment
terms.sec3.p: Prices are shown in Costa Rican colones (CRC) and include VAT where applicable. Shipping cost depends on the delivery area and is shown before you confirm your order. You can pay by card, processed by our payment provider, or by SINPE Móvil; in that case the order is confirmed once we verify the payment.
terms.sec4.title: 4. Shipping
terms.sec4.p: We only deliver within Costa Rica. In the Greater Metropolitan Area (GAM) we deliver with our own routes; outside the GAM we ship through Correos de Costa Rica. The estimated delivery time is shown at checkout and you can schedule a shipping date. You are responsible for providing the recipient's correct details; if delivery fails because of incorrect details or because nobody receives it, re-delivery may have an additional cost.
terms.sec5.title: 5. Delivery guarantee
terms.sec5.p: We guarantee the tree arrives alive and in good condition. If it arrives damaged or dead, send us a photo of the tree and its packaging by WhatsApp or email within 48 hours of delivery in the GAM, or within 72 hours of delivery by Correos de Costa Rica. We will replace it at no cost with the same species or, if it is out of stock, with an equivalent species or a refund for the tree. The guarantee does not cover damage after delivery caused by care, weather, animals or planting.
terms.sec6.title: 6. Cancellations, withdrawal and returns
terms.sec6.p: You can cancel your order at no cost before it goes out for delivery. In addition, under Costa Rica's Consumer Protection Law 7472 and its regulations, you may withdraw from the purchase within 8 business days after delivery; since it is a living plant, it must be returned in the condition in which it was received. Refunds are made through the original payment method.
terms.sec7.title: 7. Tree care
terms.sec7.p: From delivery onward, planting and caring for the tree is the recipient's responsibility. We provide the Guardian's Guide with instructions on watering, light, transplanting and observation. We recommend planting in the rainy season and watering regularly in the dry season. We cannot guarantee the tree's survival after delivery.
terms.sec8.title: 8. Map registration
terms.sec8.p: Registering the tree on the map is optional. When you do, your name, the species, the planting date, the location and any photo you upload are published on the darboles.com map; your email is never published. You can ask us to remove or correct your registration at any time. How we handle your data is explained in the Privacy Policy.
terms.sec9.title: 9. Corporate orders
terms.sec9.p: Orders from companies and institutions are governed by the quote or agreement signed with each client. These terms apply to anything that agreement does not cover.
terms.sec10.title: 10. Governing law
terms.sec10.p: These terms are governed by the laws of the Republic of Costa Rica, and any dispute will be resolved before its courts. Nothing in these terms limits your rights under consumer protection law.
terms.sec11.title: 11. Changes
terms.sec11.p: We may update these terms. The current version is the one published on this page with its update date; changes do not affect orders already confirmed.
nosotros.sec3.title: Packaging you plant whole
nosotros.sec3.p1: Every Dárboles tree arrives in 100% plantable or compostable packaging, grown in Costa Rican soil — there's nothing to unpack. When it's time to transplant, you simply bury the whole package in the ground.
nosotros.sec3.p2: The packaging breaks down organically without leaving a single gram of waste: the same material that protected the tree during shipping ends up nourishing the soil where it's planted.

steps.title: How to plant your tree
steps.subtitle: You don't take the tree out of the box: the whole box is planted. It comes with Hidrokeeper, a water-retaining polymer that helps the tree survive the dry season.
steps.hidrata.title: Soak
steps.hidrata.desc: Submerge the box with the tree in a container of water for 10 to 15 minutes.
steps.hidrata.alt: Dárboles box with its tree submerged in a container of water for 10 to 15 minutes
steps.prepara.title: Prepare the soil
steps.prepara.desc: Dig the hole and moisten it with a little water.
steps.prepara.alt: Hole dug in the ground and moistened with a watering can, next to the Dárboles box with its tree
steps.siembra.title: Plant
steps.siembra.desc: Plant the wet box in the hole and cover it completely with soil.
steps.siembra.alt: Wet Dárboles box with its tree being lowered into the hole
steps.registra.title: Register and care
steps.registra.desc: Register your tree on the Dárboles map with the code on your certificate and become its Ecosystem Guardian.
